newsitem.title: USA: IDEXX plunges on dismal earnings forecast.
newsitem.headline: IDEXX plunges on dismal earnings forecast.

text.p: The stock of IDEXX Laboratories Inc. crumbled about 63 percent in heavy trading Monday after the biotechnology company said it expects its first quarter earnings to fall significanlty below analysts' estimates.
The stock of the Westbrook, Maine-based company dropped $20 to $12 on Nasdaq volume of more than 16.7 million shares in afternoon trading.
IDEXX said earlier Monday it expected to post first quarter earnings per share in the range of 2 cents to 5 cents on revenues of about $60 million to $65 million.
Analysts had expected IDEXX to earn 21 cents a share in the first quarter, compared with 18 cents a share last year, according to First Call.
For the fourth quarter of 1996, IDEXX earned $9.2 million, or 23 cents a share, on revenues of $74.5 million.
IDEXX said the earnings shortfall was due to lower-than-anticipated sales of certain veterinary diagnostic products and a decision to decrease distributor shipments in the first and second quarters.
